# Third-party libraries

Bundled so the app works without a CDN. Not modified.

| File | Library | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pdf.min.mjs`, `pdf.worker.min.mjs` | [pdf.js](https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js) — reads PDFs | 4.10.38 | Apache-2.0 |
| `mammoth.browser.min.js` | [Mammoth](https://github.com/mwilliamson/mammoth.js) — reads Word files | 1.13.0 | BSD-2-Clause |
| `jszip.min.js` | [JSZip](https://github.com/Stuk/jszip) — builds the reports .zip | 3.10.2 | MIT |

Fonts in `../fonts/`: IBM Plex Sans and Noto Sans (Devanagari, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu), both SIL Open Font License 1.1.
Fonts in `scripts/assets/` (Caveat, Kalam; SIL Open Font License 1.1) are used only to draw the handwritten demo files.
